title: How to Qualify Leads Without Losing the Good Ones
excerpt: Loose qualification quietly kills pipeline. Here's how to tighten it without turning away real buyers.
body:
Qualification is the most under-examined stage in a remodeler's pipeline. Too loose, and your sales team wastes hours on tire-kickers. Too strict, and you accidentally filter out serious buyers who just didn't fit your script.

The fix is a short, consistent set of questions asked the same way every time — budget range, timeline, and decision-making authority — logged the same way every time. Once that's consistent, you can finally see your real qualified rate instead of guessing at it.
